text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Grass-chan's birthday gift was totally 
jaw-dropping! I never imagined—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
To think it was a "letter of challenge" 
with nothing inside, hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It's a rather unusual concept, but 
I'd be honored if you like it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I simply wanted to gift... some of my 
"passion" to Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Dominating races with overwhelming speed, 
you whom they sometimes even call a 
"monster."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Still, in those eyes, there is always... a 
smoldering fire.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A formal letter will be for when I've 
grown strong enough to stand as a rival 
before you. Until then—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You want me to hold on to that blank 
"challenge letter"... I see.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, ahaha! What a truly thrilling 
birthday present!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You've gotten me so excited. When the time 
comes... I'll show you a run that leaves 
everyone in the dust!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Try and catch me if you can âMiss 
"Monster the Second" âª
